title: Annual Science Exhibition 2026
description: Students from Class VI to XII display working models and science projects. Open to parents and the public with prizes for the best three projects.

title: Inter-School Olympiad Championship
description: A competitive Olympiad covering Mathematics, Science and General Knowledge for Class VI to X students from schools across Guwahati.

title: Career Counselling Workshop
description: Expert counsellors guide Class X and XII students on career options in Arts, Commerce, competitive exams and higher studies in Assam.

title: Saraswati Puja Celebration
description: Students and teachers celebrated Saraswati Puja together with cultural performances, traditional songs and community lunch.

title: Annual Sports Meet 2025
description: A full day of athletics, kabaddi, chess and team games where students from all batches competed with great sportsmanship.

title: Computer Literacy Camp
description: A free one-day camp teaching basic computer skills, Assamese typing and safe internet usage to students and their parents.
